note: Axis-aligned WGS84 bounding box derived from the source raster's EPSG:32643 corner coordinates reprojected with pyproj. The source raster is a north-up rectangle in UTM 43N; reprojecting an ~16km x 14km rectangle to WGS84 introduces sub-pixel meridian-convergence distortion, acceptable for a reference/visual overlay only -- this image is never used as a calculation input.
